packageRules.description: The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (ci-workflows v2.10.0): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock — language minor capped by golangci-lint's build Go, patch = the newest release of that line, never downward. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree (2026-08-23; replaces the bump rule and the minor/strict gates that papered over split ownership).

vite, @vitejs/plugin-react and vitest are ONE peer-locked unit and cannot move separately. @vitejs/plugin-react v6 declares peer vite ^8.0.0; vitest 5 declares peer vite ^6.4.0 || ^7.0.0 || ^8.0.0. Opened as separate PRs they deadlock -- the plugin PR cannot resolve because vite is too old, the vite PR cannot resolve because the plugin is too old -- and the failure surfaces as `renovate/artifacts` going red, which reads like a lockfile flake rather than a peer conflict. Grouping them is what makes the upgrade expressible at all.
